# Sydney Laser Cleaning

> Laser cleaning machine hire and on-site laser cleaning across Sydney, NSW, Australia. Rust, paint, graffiti and fire damage soot removed with no chemicals, no sandblasting and no water.

- Email: zap@sydneylasercleaning.com.au (email a photo for a free quote)
- Area: Sydney wide, on site
- Machines: 1500W continuous laser (heavy rust, thick coatings, soot on concrete) and 200W pulse laser (car panels, thin sheet, pitted rust, stone)
